what_happened.line: The committee heard three FY22 budget scenarios and the administration's recommendation of scenario two; no vote was taken on the budget.
Reaching the town manager's target would leave a gap, according to the presentation.
Questions on the FY22 budget were set for the next meeting, with an adjusted budget due late February and a budget hearing on March 17.
The committee approved the special education line item transfer 5-0, and accepted two Turkey Hill donations 5-0.
Votes on the revised reopening plans and on four policies at third read were held, but the minutes record the outcomes as not audible.

why_it_matters: The FY22 school budget is shaped here before it reaches the town budget, which is mostly taxes, so the scenario chosen and the gap to the town manager's target bear on what the schools ask residents to fund.
Chapter 70 aid, health insurance, circuit breaker and grants were still unknown, so the figures can change before the hearing.
watch_next: Q&A on the FY22 budget at the next School Committee meeting, then the adjusted budget in late February.
